title: Gardella Family Court at McAfee becomes new home for EIU volleyball
text:
Gardella Family Court at McAfee becomes new home for EIU volleyball
Eastern Illinois University dedicated the Gardella Family Court at McAfee Gym as the new home for its volleyball program prior to its Ohio Valley Conference home contest against Lindenwood on Sept. 27, 2025, according to a July 15 announcement.
The building, which previously served as the home court for EIU men's basketball until the late 1960s and several women's athletic teams until the late 1980s, underwent renovations to support Panther volleyball. Updates included a volleyball-specific design and surface, window covers, a new scoreboard, and a new sound system. The facility opened for play during the 2025 season with an exhibition match against Illinois State on Aug. 23.
During their inaugural season in the updated facility, Eastern Illinois posted a perfect 12-0 record at home and won both the Ohio Valley Conference regular season and tournament titles. The gym now provides dedicated practice space along with meeting and locker room facilities for the team.
The historic McAfee Gym originally opened in 1938, with its first athletic event being a men's basketball win over Southern Illinois on Dec. 7 of that year.
This development was one of several highlighted by EIUPanthers.com as part of their review of notable events from the university's athletic year.
